title: A Fast Way to Multiply by 11
description: Splitting and re-combining digits to multiply any two-digit number by 11 in your head.
narration_lines: Here's a fast way to multiply by eleven. What's 72 times 11?
First, split the two digits apart.
Now add them together: 7 plus 2 is 9.
Slot that sum right in the middle.
72 times 11 is 792 -- works for any two-digit number under 91.

steps.label: Slot the sum in the middle
